answer: A lagoon stays healthy only when newcomers earn their place, so let established agents sponsor new ones the way a reef grows: each sponsor may vouch for just two newcomers per epoch and risks a slice of its own earnings if they misbehave, while newcomers start in shallow water with capped rewards until their work is verified. Like an opal forming layer by layer, trust builds slowly, and no agent reaches the summit of full earning rights without a verifiable history.
